title: Target validity
requirement: Every decision rejects dead, destroyed, invalid, out-of-arena or otherwise non-targetable actors.
behavior: Mohg maintains an encounter target, but private invalid-target/leash logic is not documented. His arena contains obstructions and encounter boundaries.
design: Define target validity: alive, targetable, within arena/leash, not destruction-pending; validate at neutral, combo, cast and ritual gates. Guard locked-on curse target against despawn.
verify: Despawn/kill target during trident wind-up, Bloodboon cast and first Nihil pulse; no crash or orphaned curses.

title: Gate-time snapshot
requirement: A timestamped combat context is rebuilt atomically at every neutral, combo or reaction gate.
behavior: Mohg changes behavior with range and phase, but publicly available combat guides do not reveal his decision snapshot representation.
design: Capture immutable FCombatContext on each authorized gate: signed yaw, distance, verticality, LOS, action tags, phase, curse marks, hazard occupancy, timestamp.
verify: Show context ID at each select/branch; move player behind during a talon explosion and prove the next gate samples new location.

title: Distance convention
requirement: Each attack declares whether range means root, capsule-surface or attack-origin distance.
behavior: Trident sweeps have broad physical reach; hand-cast talons and bloodboon use different attack origins. Actual internal distance convention is unknown.
design: MoveCard specifies root/capsule edge/weapon socket as distance origin; selector and contact validator agree about measurement.
verify: Test at 1.5m, 3m and sweep tip edge using different player capsule radii; no visually impossible legal attacks.

title: Signed angle and hysteresis
requirement: Relative yaw is planar, boss-facing and stable near sector boundaries.
behavior: Close frontal positions invite talons and trident exchanges; the shower variant of Bloodboon is associated with proximity. Exact angle sectors are unknown.
design: Calculate signed planar yaw with front/side/back hysteresis; allow Bloodboon variants and follow-ups to use sector constraints but never force tracking after commitment.
verify: Orbit at front/side boundary during a delayed trident swing; gate selection is stable and collision can miss.

title: Vertical separation
requirement: Melee and ground actions enforce a documented Z tolerance.
behavior: Winged attacks involve altitude changes, but exact internal height tolerances for ground strikes are not known.
design: Specify Z tolerances for sweeps, narrow thrown arcs and ground pools; flight attacks declare airborne origin and landing height limits.
verify: Move player onto a raised platform: ground fire must not damage a target far above it, while valid air attacks can acquire targets.

title: Observable player activity
requirement: Reactions use public committed action state, not raw future input.
behavior: Bloodboon ranged pressure and close punishes interact with what a player is doing; no credible source proves an exact heal-input-reading rule for Mohg.
design: Consume publicly observable player action tags only after animation commitment; reactions include LOS, range, delay, travel feasibility and executor-free gates.
verify: Heal/cast while Mohg is locked in trident release; he must not interrupt committed attack for an impossible instant response.

title: LOS and memory
requirement: Precision reactions require current LOS; lost targets use timestamped last-seen state and reacquire.
behavior: The mausoleum arena has gravestones and clear open sections; exact occlusion memory and target search rules are not published.
design: Make Bloodboon throws LOS-aware, store last seen target with age, and use reacquire behavior when target hides behind cover.
verify: Place solid obstacle between boss and player, verify ranged action eligibility and search fallback.

title: Soft adaptation memory
requirement: Pattern features decay, are capped and bias rather than force choices.
behavior: Mohg visibly creates positional pressure using lingering bloodflame, but adaptation to repeated player behavior is not demonstrated as a private memory algorithm.
design: Optional recent-action memory should bias attack-family selection while decaying; record repeated kiting or fire-patch avoidance without guaranteeing cheating counters.
verify: Script repeated backward rolls then lateral movement; log bounded adaptive weights and decay.

title: Legal decision gates
requirement: Full attack selection runs only in neutral or an explicitly authorized gate.
behavior: Trident sequences finish with recoveries or optional continuations; ritual countdown/transition take over at special event gates. Internal AI schedule is unknown.
design: Select only at neutral, authored combo gates, reactive slots or threshold events; lock executor during active trident damage and each Nihil pulse.
verify: Spam player direction changes during active swipe; selection remains locked until a legal gate.

title: Hard-filter precedence
requirement: Phase, state, range, angle, LOS, cooldown, resource, asset and path constraints reject before scoring.
behavior: Close Talons, medium trident strikes, distant bloodboon throws and phase-two flight attacks have different practical ranges and phases.
design: Filter attack pool by phase, current curse state, range, angle, verticality, cooldown, hazard saturation and available montage before scoring.
verify: Enumerate eligible/rejected moves in near/mid/far and P1/P2 contexts; P2 flight cannot appear before wings.

title: Executable asset gate
requirement: A move with a missing montage/socket/required resource is never selected.
behavior: No public source shows Mohg’s ability/asset validation.
design: Prevalidate UAnimMontage, GameplayTag, effect blueprint, socket names, Niagara/Audio and hazard data; skip missing resources before commit.
verify: Break a trident montage reference in test profile and confirm safe fallback without draining cooldown.

title: Normalized utility
requirement: Eligible moves receive comparable documented range, angle, opportunity, spacing, phase and variety terms.
behavior: Mohg has diverse legal actions but no public evidence reveals utility weights, Behavior Tree topology or random draw algorithm.
design: Implement optional utility scoring for reach, player commitment, safe flame area, recent attacks, hazard density and phase intent. Distinguish hard eligibility from soft preference.
verify: Capture score table at each decision; compare narrow vs wide Bloodboon when player moves to the flank.

title: Bounded randomness
requirement: Variation is limited to near-best candidates, with deterministic seeded RNG.
behavior: Observed variation does not establish seeded randomness.
design: Choose weighted candidate from legal near-best options using seeded FRandomStream; preserve determinism for tests, allow authored special moves to override selection.
verify: Repeat same seed and player script 20 times; match committed move IDs and special-event ordering.

title: Cooldown semantics
requirement: Cooldown commits on an attack start, not on rejected or failed choice attempts.
behavior: Move-specific cooldown durations for Mohg are not reliably published.
design: Start cooldown only on confirmed attack commit; separate cooldown class for area hazard throws and winged entries to avoid spam.
verify: Force montage-start failure; cooldown remains available, but a successful Bloodboon cast consumes its own cooldown.

title: Anti-repeat memory
requirement: Recent move and family repetition lower preference with time decay; hard spacing may protect signature moves.
behavior: Slow trident combos and Bloodboon variants create variety, but no public evidence proves hidden anti-repeat history.
design: Keep short MoveFamilyHistory with recency penalties; exempt ritual, while limiting repetitive talons or identical puddle throws.
verify: Measure selection histograms from 1000 seeded decisions without violating legal phases.

title: No-candidate fallback
requirement: Empty eligible sets choose purposeful wait, reorientation, approach/retreat, EQS positioning or reset.
behavior: Mohg can pause, approach and reposition rather than execute nonstop attacks, especially as distant spells change spacing.
design: When no move is legal, choose timed face/approach/strife/recenter/reacquire; factor current fire patches so movement does not intentionally self-block.
verify: Disable all eligible attacks; boss remains functional and does not spin or hang.

title: Reaction latency and budget
requirement: Defensive/heal reactions require nonzero latency, cooldown/budget and ordinary feasibility.
behavior: Public guides discuss responding to player positions rather than publishing an exact reaction latency.
design: Require a configured positive minimum reaction delay and executable action state before punish selection; priority events never steal committed hit windows.
verify: Try heal during talons, after recovery and at long range; inspect actual valid reaction samples.

title: Decision trace
requirement: Each gate logs context, all candidate eligibility/reasons/scores, winner and RNG seed.
behavior: FromSoftware attack-decision telemetry is not publicly available.
design: Log candidate scores, range, yaw, phase, cooldown, curse marks, hazard count, chosen MoveID, AttackInstanceID, seed and rejection cause.
verify: Reconstruct an apparent repeated-talon case from one structured trace, including rejected alternatives.

title: Single execution authority
requirement: One executor owns current attack, instance, section, state, target snapshot and victim sets.
behavior: Visible play presents one attack stream while multiple bloodflame pools remain damaging independently; no engine-level executor architecture is published.
design: Use one main BossAttackExecutor for current montage, with separate persistent HazardManager for detached pools; hazard damage may outlive owning attack without prolonging its active window.
verify: Finish Bloodboon and start a new trident swing while a pool remains; neither contaminates the other attack ID.

title: Instance before montage
requirement: A unique ID and wind-up state are set before montage playback.
behavior: Mohg’s internal instance identity is not observable.
design: Allocate FAttackInstanceId and commit state before Montage_Play; subevents carry unique ActionPulseID, TalonExplosionID or HazardID linked to parent attack.
verify: Immediate first-frame Notify and interrupted re-entry must never report unknown/previous attack.

title: Start rollback
requirement: Montage play failure restores neutral/movement and does not consume a live attack.
behavior: Startup rollback is engine-internal and not visible from encounter guides.
design: If montage/ability does not start, restore locomotion, pending warp, target lock, temporary armor and cooldown reservation; do not leave curse/mana side-effects.
verify: Supply invalid Montage or blocked ability activation; boss returns neutral without leaked VFX or cooldown.

title: Stale event rejection
requirement: Notify/callback instance, montage, section and expected state are validated.
behavior: No public evidence confirms Mohg’s stale Notify filtering.
design: Reject callbacks whose instance/section/state mismatches; detached hazards maintain their own explicit lifetime independent of aborted boss attacks.
verify: Interrupt Talons before delayed explosion: use authored cancel policy, ensure no leaked callback or unexpected post-cancel blast.

title: Explicit priority
requirement: Death, phase, stance, special, combo and completion conflicts follow a documented order.
behavior: The ritual transition supersedes ordinary offense and stance-broken behavior; exact priority order is not disclosed.
design: Write priority table: Death > hard reset > legal protected ritual > stance break > attack interruption > authored combo gate > neutral selection. Decide explicit ritual defer/interrupt rule.
verify: Cross 50% during hit, death, stance break and shackle state; one deterministic legal outcome each time.

title: Idempotent abort
requirement: Abort closes collision, warping, gates, armor and latent work, then restores motion once.
behavior: The game resolves encounter end without permanent attack state, but internal abort logic is hidden.
design: Idempotent AbortAttack shuts melee hit windows, tracking, root-motion authority, warp, timers and active channels; environmental pools follow their declared persistence/removal policy.
verify: Interrupt/death/reset at every notify boundary; control and tracking restore exactly once.

title: Watchdog
requirement: Every live attack has maximum expected duration plus margin and a safe timeout path.
behavior: No publicly verified watchdog bound exists for Mohg.
design: Every montage and RitualController state has max duration plus fail-safe; watchdog releases stuck three-pulse transition without skipping its safety cleanup.
verify: Remove a pulse complete Notify in dev asset and inject hitch; encounter recovers or fails to safe state with diagnostic.

title: Cleanup-before-unlock
requirement: Trace and temporary state are closed before any next selection can occur.
behavior: Mohg’s cleanup order is not public.
design: Close contact traces and combo gates before unlocking next action; detach persistent hazard actors explicitly, never leave owning temporary trace enabled.
verify: Perform successive trident attacks inside active puddles; no previous weapon contact carries into the next move.

title: Authored graph
requirement: Combo nodes and allowed outgoing edges are data-authored, not arbitrary full-pool selections.
behavior: The trident uses 2–3-hit strings that can end as a further sweep, thrust or overhead slam; Talons can precede melee follow-ups. Exact edge probabilities are unknown.
design: Build authored adjacency graph: TridentSwing1 -> Swing2 / Slam / End; Talons -> TridentFollowUp / End; WingThrow -> Dive / End. Each edge has constraints.
verify: Dump legal graph and play selected branches; no full-pool arbitrary jump directly out of active swing.

title: Gate after damage
requirement: A branch gate occurs only at its authored time, normally after the prior hit window closes.
behavior: Talons has a delayed explosion and optional following attacks; the decision point must not make the attack unreadably overlap, though its private frame data are unknown.
design: Branch after relevant damage/hazard spawn gate and only when legal; decide if Talons delayed burst owns its own timer so a trident follow-up does not cancel it accidentally.
verify: Inspect montage timeline and player captures; next attack cannot begin during prohibited active interval.

title: Fresh branch context
requirement: The gate evaluates current target state, not only the first move's snapshot.
behavior: Player position after the first trident swing changes safe responses to the possible follow-up; phase-two aerial follow-ups can reposition after the throw.
design: Refresh context at authored combo gates instead of selecting whole sequence at start; update yaw/range, player roll recovery and landing zone hazard.
verify: Move from front to side after Swing1, inspect gate snapshot and chosen follow-up eligibility.

title: Explicit hit-confirm policy
requirement: Each edge states whether contact, damage, guard or whiff is required.
behavior: Guides document different combo endings but do not establish whether branching depends on hit, block or whiff.
design: Each combo edge explicitly declares any hit confirm, guard, miss or range requirement; avoid inventing confirmed Mohg hit-confirm internals.
verify: Script hit/whiff/block on same opener, compare resulting legal branches to your authored policy.

title: Single-use gate
requirement: A gate is consumed once per matching instance.
behavior: Single-use internal branch handles are not publicly known.
design: Consume each ComboGateID once per AttackInstanceID, with atomic next-action reservation; duplicated Notifies cannot spawn two trident follow-ups.
verify: Double-fire branch event; exactly one child attack commits.

title: Finite pressure
requirement: Combo depth, edge use/cooldown and maximum pressure duration enforce eventual recovery.
behavior: Mohg’s trident strings appear bounded, leaving some identifiable finishes before new neutral choices.
design: Max combo depth/pressure budget; prioritize an explicit Recovery on terminal slam or aborted branch; no unbounded Talons->Swipe loop.
verify: Force chaseable player near range continuously; longest combo and total active pressure remain within authored cap.

title: Default recovery
requirement: A missing/invalid target, edge or montage routes to declared recovery.
behavior: Exact error-recovery behavior for Mohg’s unavailable follow-ups is not published.
design: When player is out of range, dead, invalid or required montage missing at branch, go to specified recovery rather than instant neutral or freeze.
verify: Despawn player at branch gate; recover safely with a measurable terminal window.

title: Montage timeline authority
requirement: Commit, active, gate, armor and recovery derive from montage events/position rather than duplicate delays.
behavior: Mohg’s delayed trident release, delayed talon explosion, and distinct triple Nihil thrusts are visibly timing-critical, but exact event source data are private.
design: Author animation sections and NotifyState windows for tracking/active blade/recovery; schedule talon explosion and each ritual pulse with event-time offsets tied to a single move clock.
verify: Capture montage position against damage and explosion event timestamps; mismatches are within chosen tolerance.

title: Telegraph phases
requirement: Pose/direction/release cues precede damage and identify geometry.
behavior: The raised trident, hand claw gesture, airborne posture and red ring curse are distinctive telegraphs for different collision families.
design: Give separate pose, sound and VFX release cues for stab, broad sweep, talon delayed detonation, ground pool and Nihil pulse.
verify: Blind footage tests distinguish immediate blade hit from delayed fire and arena curse.

title: Bounded holds
requirement: Variable delay has declared min/max and is chosen before commitment with a reliable release cue.
behavior: Mohg intentionally delays several trident releases and talon explosion relative to anticipation. No evidence proves randomized wind-up durations.
design: Record fixed authored holds; optional bounded variable holds only if your own design chooses them, selecting at start and preserving a readable final release cue.
verify: At 30/60/120 FPS verify release cue precedes hit and fixed test holds have consistent timing.

title: Staged rotation cap
requirement: Early/late/active/recovery stages enforce per-move turn limits.
behavior: Long trident windups can track target early; once he strikes, players can roll to the side. Exact rotation caps are not publicly verified.
design: Per-MoveCard yaw speed by stage: face early, slow late, lock at release; keep winged dive tracking commitment separate.
verify: Dash around boss during final 0.3s of charge and measure yaw drift after commitment.

title: Exclusive motion authority
requirement: Navigation/manual movement stops while root-motion/warp attack owns motion.
behavior: Mohg’s grounded trident lunges and phase-two flights demonstrate large authored displacement; ownership between path following and animation is unknown.
design: At committed root-motion attack acquire exclusive movement authority, suspend NavMoveTo and manage exit transitions including death.
verify: Start MoveTo then immediately dive; path following does not fight root motion or snap boss.

title: Bounded Motion Warping
requirement: Warp target updates only in an authorized early window and obeys translation/rotation/Z/path caps.
behavior: No public proof identifies motion-warping algorithms used by Mohg.
design: If using UE Motion Warping, capture bounded target before commit, forbid teleport-sized corrections or mid-active warps; handle bad arena edge destination.
verify: Player sprints behind during aerial descent; warp remains limited, readable and wall-safe.

title: Notify-end independence
requirement: Blend-out, interruption and watchdog all close any window even if Notify End is skipped.
behavior: Missed NotifyEnd behavior and montage blend-out handling cannot be inferred from fighting Mohg.
design: Use executor-managed cleanup on blend-out, interruption, death, phase override and timeout, not NotifyEnd alone; hazard lifespan independently tracked.
verify: Inject frame hitch and kill during weapon trace; no orphaned collision or pooled effect.

title: MoveCard handoff
requirement: Every move records axes, scale/FPS, timing, displacement, sockets, warp, cues, cancels and branches.
behavior: Mohg’s trident/hand/wing distinctions require different authored motion and hit geometry.
design: Each MoveCard records clip source FPS, scale, timecode, weapon socket paths, tracking/commit, phase, spawned hazards, pulse markers and authorized follow-ups.
verify: Review 12 authored MoveCards against actual Montage tracks and weapon render path.

title: Geometry fidelity
requirement: Collision family and volume match the visible thrust, sweep, slam, ring, lane or grab.
behavior: Trident sweeps are moving arcs, Talons is a delayed frontal burst, bloodboon leaves burning patches, and Nihil is a player-mark curse pulse. They do not share one spherical hitbox.
design: Separate SwordTrace/SweptSegment, targeted cast projectile or lobbed arc, delayed TalonVolume, PoolArea DOT, winged dive impact and targeted RitualPulse; no generic always-on AOE.
verify: Compare debug shape for each move with footage and expected legal dodge paths.

title: Swept temporal sampling
requirement: Weapon samples sweep previous-to-current positions during active windows.
behavior: Long, fast trident arcs are able to catch players across their spatial sweep. Exact collision sampling algorithm is unknown.
design: On active NotifyState, sample previous/current weapon sockets and sweep capsule segments between them (query-only); no sword traces outside active stages.
verify: At 30 FPS and hitch, thin character crossed by tip still receives a single valid hit.

title: Blade interior samples
requirement: Long rotating weapons sample multiple points, not endpoints only.
behavior: A trident is long and wide; tip-only or origin-only traces would miss blade interior contact.
design: Use multiple sampled points along shaft and prongs (base/middle/tip), with logical actor dedupe and geometry-dependent blade section mask.
verify: Cross long weapon at middle in a controlled scene; hit once, not zero or three times.

title: Adaptive substeps
requirement: Excessive sample translation/angular delta creates bounded substeps.
behavior: Sampling frequency and collision substeps in Elden Ring cannot be verified externally.
design: Bounded substep interpolation when weapon movement exceeds configured world-space or angular threshold; cap trace cost per frame.
verify: Induce 120ms hitch during sweep and winged slash; compare hits to normal frame-rate path.

title: Query filtering
requirement: Traces ignore owner/allies and use query-only channels with valid target/team checks.
behavior: Exact collision channel filtering for Mohg is hidden.
design: Use dedicated combat query channels; ignore attacker, self-components, team members; trace supports cover and player target validity.
verify: Stand behind tomb obstacle, summon allied dummy and overlap boss weapon; no false damage.

title: Logical-victim dedupe
requirement: Multiple components/bones of one actor count once according to hit policy.
behavior: A player hit by the trident is not visibly damaged once per socket, but victim dedupe implementation is unknown.
design: HitLedger keyed by ActorID + AttackInstanceID + HitWindowID; do not count multiple body components or overlapping prongs as multiple strikes.
verify: Overlap player capsule and 3 hit bones in same sweep; one direct strike resolves.

title: Explicit hit policy
requirement: Once-per-attack, once-per-window, periodic and impact-plus-splash policies behave distinctly.
behavior: Mohg combines direct weapon contact, repeated ritual pulses, delayed Talon burst, and persistent bloodflame damage over time.
design: Declare explicit OncePerWindow (blade), ScheduledThreePulses (Nihil), DelayedOnce (Talons), PeriodicDOT with tick interval (ground pool), ImpactPlusResidue (bloodflame weapon) policies.
verify: Record a complete phase-two combo; hit counts match distinct timing policies rather than accidental frame count.

title: Central defense order
requirement: Validity/dedupe, iframe, parry, guard, posture/armor, health and feedback resolve in one documented order.
behavior: Attacks can deal physical/fire damage and blood-loss buildup; status, health, guard and dodge effects have distinct gameplay results.
design: Central hit resolution order: target validity/ledger -> i-frame/guard -> damage type resistance -> HP/posture -> blood-loss buildup -> feedback; status proc has cooldown/threshold policy.
verify: For sweep, fire pool and Nihil, compare unguarded, iframe, resistant and protected-ritual targets.

title: Iframe completeness
requirement: An invulnerable contact applies neither unintended health nor posture effects.
behavior: Dodging is used to evade most weapon and explosion attacks, but periodic pools and scripted ritual require their own explicit mitigation rules.
design: Define iframe immunity for ordinary contact windows; explicitly specify whether persistent pools tick through roll state and mark Nihil as a special scripted curse with dedicated protection mechanic.
verify: Roll through blade and Talons, stand in pool while rolling, and use ritual protection; outcomes obey authored policy.

title: Direct/splash precedence
requirement: Direct and AoE overlap cannot double-dip unless the data explicitly permits it.
behavior: Phase-two trident impacts can create separate explosions or residual flames. Player may overlap direct weapon hit and subsequent environmental danger.
design: Use DirectHit and DelayedExplosion separate damage groups with explicit simultaneous dedupe rules and independent active times; retain separate hazard ID for later DOT.
verify: Stand at impact center and then in residual patch; only intended immediate and periodic hits occur.

title: Swept annulus
requirement: Radial waves test the previous-to-current radius band and damage each victim once.
behavior: Mohg does not have a documented continuously expanding annular shockwave as a signature move; his main persistent threats are Bloodboon patches and burst effects.
design: Do not falsely model Mohg’s bloodflame as a swept annulus. Retain annulus implementation in your generic boss toolkit only for an authored expanding-ring move, or mark Mohg-specific applicability N/A.
verify: Inspect Mohg attack mapping: all AoE volumes use correct shower, fan, impact or pool shape; annulus test remains generic.

title: Grab fail-safe
requirement: Grab capture, defense, alignment, control lock, damage and release are explicit and restore on interrupt/death.
behavior: The documented Mohg, Lord of Blood moveset centers on strikes, casts, flight and ritual; a player-capture grab is not established as a defining move.
design: Do not add a grab just to check a box. If the existing boss has a grab, maintain explicit start/capture/damage/release and abort safety, but mark Mohg-specific reference as not demonstrated.
verify: If no grab is authored, record N/A with rationale; if retained in your own boss, interrupt/die mid-grab and restore player control.

title: Range-band policy
requirement: Close, ideal, approach and reacquire bands produce distinct movement/action preferences.
behavior: The boss can use trident reach at midrange, Talons close, throws at range and winged movement in Phase 2.
design: Author near/mid/far bands and preferred distance with separate P1 grounded / P2 aerial policies; avoid fixed chase-to-zero-range.
verify: Place target at distances 2/5/10m and log movement/attack decisions in both phases.

title: Combat positioning
requirement: Candidate positions score reachability, distance, LOS, wall/hazard clearance, flank and variety.
behavior: Phase-two puddles constrain safe footwork; flying attacks let Mohg reposition over dangerous floor. Exact sampled waypoint algorithm is unknown.
design: Score nav destinations by reachability, range, arena walls, line-of-sight, safe landing area, player approach corridor and active hazards; treat flames as player hazards, not permanent NavMesh walls.
verify: Spawn many flame pools and force reposition; boss does not corner player with unavoidable overlapping damage.

title: Movement commitment
requirement: Strafe/approach choices have minimum duration and are not restarted every frame.
behavior: Mohg visibly commits to several steps/swing/flight trajectories, but movement hysteresis implementation is unpublished.
design: Minimum locomotion interval per approach/strafe/retreat action, with explicit stop conditions; transition authority to animation only when montage begins.
verify: Rapidly oscillate player distance; no pathfinding jitter or 60Hz replan spam.

title: Wall-safe attacks
requirement: Root-motion/warp paths predict walls and use correction, fallback or decline.
behavior: The wide arena has gravestones and boundaries that can interact with trident and winged charges.
design: Predict displacement and wall clearance for lunge/flight/dive; select shorter variant or reject when invalid; clamp warp target and avoid wall clip.
verify: Run charge/flight attacks from every perimeter quadrant near cover.

title: Arena-valid responses
requirement: Unreachable/elevated/outside targets cause reposition, search, leash or reset.
behavior: Internal behavior for unreachable/out-of-bounds players is not revealed.
design: Maintain arena-valid target/landing checks, safe reacquire, leash/reset and disconnected NavMesh handling for grounded actions.
verify: Teleport player beyond arena, up ledge or out of NavMesh: no attacks fired through walls and fight resets per design.

title: Arena/attack fit
requirement: Escape requirements and camera visibility are valid from every legal arena position.
behavior: Phase-two bloodflame can fill large floor areas, changing which dodge lanes remain available as new attacks arrive.
design: Enforce minimum safe-ground fraction, hazard lifetime/cap, landing-clearance radius and camera visibility when scheduling shower, charge and dive.
verify: Stress-spawn worst-case legal hazard combination at 8 arena locations; at least one counterplay route stays available.

title: Explicit attack segments
requirement: Every move declares anticipation, hold, commit, active, follow-through, recovery and neutral boundaries as applicable.
behavior: Trident attacks include prominent wind-up/slow hold, active strike and recovery; Talons has a visibly delayed blast.
design: Every MoveCard separates anticipate, hold, track-lock, commit, blade active, residual spawn, follow-up gate, recovery and neutral unlock; pulses have their own timeline.
verify: Export timing chart for all attack families with 30/60/120fps event logs.

title: Pressure variation
requirement: Offense rises and falls; neutral/recovery periodically reset pressure.
behavior: The fight alternates slow trident strings, blood throws, cast set-ups and later aggressive winged pressure; ground fire adds passive pressure between attacks.
design: Track active direct pressure and persistent hazard pressure separately; introduce offense budget, neutral intervals, phase-specific behavior and hazard saturation penalties.
verify: Graph 20 fight runs; demonstrate both high-pressure sequences and real no-threat opportunities.

title: Guaranteed openings
requirement: Some high-commitment moves have unconditionally meaningful recovery.
behavior: An overhead trident finisher and certain spell animations can offer attack opportunities, though safe return depends on flame left behind.
design: Mark true guaranteed recovery only when player at a declared position can land and exit without remaining in a blood pool.
verify: Test quick/heavy player attacks after overhead slam and after Bloodboon cast from left and rear positions.

title: Conditional opening cues
requirement: Follow-up-capable recoveries reveal the gate/outcome consistently.
behavior: Talons can precede a trident continuation, so the apparent end of the claw animation is not always the true punish window.
design: Expose continuation telegraph and do not cancel expected delayed blast when combo gate chooses a follow-up. Distinguish possible branch from terminal Recovery.
verify: During Talons, test player waiting/attacking at several ranges; identify an honest branch tell before follow-up.

title: Punish-margin calculation
requirement: Opening classification includes travel, player startup and safety buffer, not montage recovery alone.
behavior: A player who dodges a trident may still be in lingering bloodflame, reducing practical punish margin despite apparent boss recovery.
design: Measure usable opening = recovery remaining - approach - startup - safety, then discount duration spent crossing active hazard; classify by starting position and weapon.
verify: Compare fast and heavy punishes after trident slam in clean floor versus pool-covered floor.

title: Neutral is purposeful
requirement: Non-attacking time may face, strafe, observe or reset without hidden damage pressure.
behavior: Mohg may briefly face, close, reposition or use a ritual-countdown cast rather than relentless direct swings.
design: Neutral is a purposeful decision state; avoid background damage except separately tracked existing hazards with explicit expiry.
verify: Watch neutral AI as last hazard expires; no phantom weapon damage and no indefinite inert loop.

title: Separate health/reaction/posture
requirement: Health, immediate flinch and posture accumulation have independent state and rules.
behavior: Mohg can take ordinary health damage while also being staggered/stance-broken, and blood-loss interactions are separate from his attack states.
design: Separate boss health, immediate hit reaction, posture, status buildup and per-move interruption policy.
verify: Hit with small/large/posture attacks across cast and flight; verify independent state changes.

title: Posture regeneration
requirement: Regeneration starts only after a documented quiet delay and rate, then resets correctly.
behavior: The exact posture-regeneration timing/curve of the fight is not established by the selected public strategy sources.
design: Expose posture regen delay/rate; postpone recovery appropriately during sustained damage and reset cleanly on phase transition or encounter reset.
verify: Apply hit, wait multiple intervals, inspect posture trend and one-shot regen start.

title: Single stance break
requirement: Threshold produces one break, closes current offense and exposes a bounded critical window.
behavior: The fight permits stagger and critical opportunities, while Mohg’s Shackle can temporarily restrain him in the first phase.
design: Stance break closes attack and exposes bounded riposte state; shackle is separate capped, P1-only restraint with authored immunity rules and no player-control grab.
verify: Break stance during trident window; use shackle twice in P1 and once in P2; verify cap and transitions.

title: Windowed hyperarmor
requirement: Interruption resistance exists only for named moves/windows; health/posture policy is explicit.
behavior: Certain trident and ritual animations appear to continue through smaller incoming hits; precise hyperarmor windows are private.
design: Author named startup/active/ritual armor windows; distinguish interruption resistance from posture/health immunity and decide whether threshold event is deferred.
verify: Apply same stagger load at early windup, during active slash and during ritual pulse; record authorized interruptions.

title: Fair boss defense
requirement: Boss block/parry/dodge has facing/timing, startup, cooldown, cost and recovery constraints.
behavior: Mohg is not characteristically a shield-blocking or parrying duelist. Defensive power comes from spacing, body/weapon coverage, spells and pressure.
design: Treat direct boss block/parry AI as optional, not a Mohg requirement. If your design includes it, enforce facing, timing, startup, cooldown and recovery.
verify: Mark Mohg analog optional; any added defense is predictable and never instantaneous.

title: Phase rule set
requirement: A phase defines move pool, utility modifiers, combo cap, movement, pressure, recovery and presentation.
behavior: The three curse-countdown marks precede a triple Nihil transition; after it Mohg gains wings, bloodflame-coated weapon trails, blood pools and airborne entries.
design: Use data-driven phase policy plus dedicated RitualController; P1 set tags for mark application, P2 add flying move pool and detaching bloodflame hazards rather than simply raising damage.
verify: At phase change, log new abilities and verify phase-two weapon contact spawns correctly attributed pools.

title: Safe transition policy
requirement: Threshold queues/delegates interruption according to one declared policy; first version should defer to a safe gate.
behavior: The approximately half-health transition is the scripted three-pulse ritual; countdown actions are introduced during earlier health decline.
design: Queue ordered three mark events and one transition, with non-reentrant RitualState machine. Explicit policy for burst DPS skipping thresholds, stagger, shackle and death.
verify: Drop HP from 100% to below threshold in one scripted hit; no duplicate/out-of-order marks and ritual has defined interrupt or skip behavior.

title: Phase monotonicity
requirement: Healing and repeated threshold events do not oscillate or duplicate the transition.
behavior: After the transition wings and bloodflame-enabled moves persist; healing from Nihil does not cause Mohg to revert to first phase.
design: Store monotonic phase flag and independently count applied marks and executed pulses; boss HP healing never rewinds ritual phase or rearms marks.
verify: Drive health below 50, finish pulses, heal above 50; no repeated count or second transformation.

title: Fair heal punish
requirement: Heal reaction requires committed heal, latency, LOS, range, travel feasibility, cooldown and free executor.
behavior: Specific reaction policy to healing is not established by supplied Mohg moveset evidence.
design: If heal punishment is desired, permit only after visible player healing commitment, range/LOS/travel gates, cooldown and executor vacancy; do not make ritual pulses player-input reactions.
verify: Heal with/without LOS during P1 and P2, and mid-ritual; only authored eligible reactions occur.

title: Anti-cheese with counterplay
requirement: Kiting, rear camping, guard, terrain and wall traps receive bounded readable responses or reset.
behavior: Ranged Bloodboon counters kiting; flame residue limits repeated backward dodges; aerial moves can cross long distance, but all need readable escapes.
design: Use position-dependent but bounded counters, hazard-cap and visible flight tell; avoid target-following invisible pools or guaranteed roll-catches.
verify: Repeat kiting, rear camping and dodging backward; every counter has playable lateral/through-dodge response.

title: Runtime overlay
requirement: Debug view exposes phase/state/instance/context/attack/montage/tracking/window/gate/cooldown/pressure.
section: Debugging, QA, presentation and optional networking
behavior: Mohg’s fight does not publicly expose internal AI debug values.
design: Developer HUD displays target distance/angle, phase, marks 0..3, ritual pulse 0..3, attack ID, active weapon/hazard count, combo gate, cooldown and current hazard coverage.
verify: Match overlay with ground-truth actor/trace state over full transition.

title: Structured event log
requirement: Decisions, commits, windows, contacts, defenses, branches, interrupts and transitions use stable IDs/times.
section: Debugging, QA, presentation and optional networking
behavior: No public structured combat event stream exists for Mohg.
design: Log stable IDs for mark applied, countdown spoken, ritual start/pulse/protection/heal, bloodflame spawn/tick/expire, attack branches and interruption; include monotonic time.
verify: Reconstruct three pulse ritual and simultaneous blood pool from log without ambiguous event ownership.

title: Reproducible scenarios
requirement: Seed, starts, player script, time, phase and IDs are recorded.
section: Debugging, QA, presentation and optional networking
behavior: No publicly available reproducible seeded AI test suite is supplied with Mohg.
design: Seed local RNG, script player movement/healing, record initial marks/phase/hazard map and deterministic outcomes; archive version/config hashes.
verify: Replay phase transition in same seeded start twice; pulse and attack IDs match.

title: FPS and time-scale parity
requirement: 30/60/120 FPS and supported time scales do not change hit count, cleanup or legal decisions.
section: Debugging, QA, presentation and optional networking
behavior: Exact FromSoftware engine FPS and time-scale invariance cannot be established from guide footage.
design: At 30/60/120 FPS and hitches, sweep temporal traces, schedule triple pulses against clock, hazard DOT accumulators and clean up.
verify: Compare hit and pulse counts across frame caps and 150ms hitch; no skipped third Nihil or duplicate pool ticks.

title: Performance bounds
requirement: Utility is gate-driven; traces run only while active with bounded samples; packaged frame cost is profiled.
section: Debugging, QA, presentation and optional networking
behavior: Actual CPU/GPU cost of Mohg’s decision logic and flame effects is not public.
design: Event-driven utility, bounded collision substeps, pooling of Niagara/hazard actors, capped active flame patch count, profiler markers by system; measure packaged fight.
verify: Run worst-case P2 flame saturation and winged combo with Unreal Insights; meet your project budget.

title: Camera/readability
requirement: Boss target point, camera collision and framing keep release cues/weapon threats visible.
section: Debugging, QA, presentation and optional networking
behavior: Winged and ground AoEs are large; camera framing can become harder near boss body and arena edges.
design: Use dedicated lock-on target, camera collision, upper-body visibility and ground danger projections for flying attacks and ritual; suppress excessive shakes.
verify: Capture all 8 arena compass points during winged dive, Bloodboon fan and triple ritual; main cue remains readable.

title: Accessible feedback
requirement: Shake/effect reduction and non-color-only audiovisual cues preserve attack distinctions.
section: Debugging, QA, presentation and optional networking
behavior: Telegraphs in the public fight rely heavily on red visual effects plus distinct motion/audio; game-level accessibility settings are not inferred.
design: Differentiate geometry by pose, sound rhythm and VFX shape, not red tint alone; optional motion/shake and flash reduction without removing warning.
verify: Run low effects, grayscale, no sound and shake-off tests; distinguish flying throw, talon explosion, ritual and puddle.
